kodiak_frontier_narrative: Bay Area urban folks drive 35 miles to find a town with one grocery store — Pescadero, population ~2k on the San Mateo Coast, where Stage Road ends at the Marsh. The nearest Costco is 30 miles away in Redwood City; the only store in town is Arcangeli Grocery Co., since 1929, where the artichoke bread still steams. Here KODIAK® is the frontier pantry: protein-packed whole grains you stock direct (frontier true, subscriber_variant true, fulfillment direct) because the frontier has no chain. On the Marsh boardwalk and the Half Moon Bay Trail, it is fitness fuel — 14g before the fog burns off, Bear Bites in the pack. At the farm stands it is seasons — Castroville artichokes Mar-Jun (centerfold April) folded with Harley Farms spring chevre into savory Power Waffles, Fifth Crow strawberries May-Sep simmered to compote, estate olive oil from the fall press, and Brussels sprouts Sep-Feb roasted for winter stacks. KODIAK® Nourishment for Today's Frontier meets the Bay Area hinterland: Feed the city, find the coast.
